description: Create a new asset. Requires assets:write scope. IMPORTANT - Location hierarchy: always resolve top-down by calling list_sites first, then list_buildings filtered by site_id, then list_locations filtered by building_id. Provide all three IDs (site_id, building_id, location_id) explicitly. System hierarchy: similarly resolve via list_system_classes → list_system_groups → list_systems.

archived_reason.description: Why the asset is archived. Kept only while it is archived.

building_id.description: Building ID - resolve second via list_buildings filtered by site_id

consequence_of_failure_score.description: Consequence of failure score, 1-5. Setting it makes it a manual value that a system change no longer replaces; send null to return it to the default from its system.

environmental_impact.description: Environmental impact level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

likelihood_of_failure_score.description: Likelihood of failure score, 1-5. Derived from condition_score unless set: setting it makes it a manual value that condition changes no longer replace; send null to return it to derivation.

location_id.description: Location ID - resolve last via list_locations filtered by building_id

regulatory_impact.description: Regulatory impact level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

replacement_value.description: Cost to replace this asset today, in current dollars. Distinct from purchase_cost, which is what was paid and is the depreciation basis.

reputation_impact.description: Reputation impact level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

safety_impact.description: Safety impact level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

service_impact.description: Service impact level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

site_id.description: Site ID - resolve first via list_sites

status_id.description: Status ID from list_asset_statuses. The status with system_key archived archives the asset; any other status restores it.

system_class_id.description: System class ID - resolve first via list_system_classes

system_group_id.description: System group ID - resolve second via list_system_groups filtered by system_class_id

system_id.description: System ID - resolve last via list_systems filtered by system_group_id

name: create_asset
title: Create asset
